versions.content: If SoAdSocketUdpStrictHeaderLenCheckEnabled is enabled SoAd shall check if the length of the received UDP message does match the accumulated length of all PDUs inc luding their PDU headers prior to forwarding any data to an upper layer. If the their lengths are different SoAd shall silently drop the whole message without forwarding any data.
